autoComplete._comment: TODO(aya): confirm — days after completed_by_provider before a booking auto-completes if the customer does nothing. Suggested default: 7. enabled=false means the cron job stub runs but takes no action; do not flip to true until confirmed.

files._comment: maxFileSizeMb is CONFIRMED at 20 MB by the product owner. maxTotalPerBookingMb is TODO(aya): confirm — deliberately generous so it never blocks normal use; suggested default 500.

messaging._comment: TODO(aya): confirm — days after a booking reaches completed before the thread goes read-only. Suggested default: 30. pollIntervalMs is a code constant, not a commercial value: the project has no realtime subscriptions today, so booking threads poll.

notifications._comment: TODO(aya): confirm both — nudgeRateLimitHours is the minimum gap between provider 'nudge customer' reminder emails on one booking (suggested 24). newMessageBatchWindowMinutes suppresses a new-message email if one was already sent for that booking within the window (suggested 15).

reviews._comment: TODO(aya): confirm all three — editableForDays is how long a customer may edit their review before it locks (suggested 14). providerReplyEditableForHours is how long a provider may edit their public reply (suggested 24). minReviewsToDisplayRating is the minimum published review count before a rating is shown on search/listing cards (suggested 1, config key exists so the threshold can be raised later).
